name: Camping 101: Blacksmithing
summary: You’re ready to make a Sharpening Wheel and try it in the wilderness. First, you’ll need a campfire to set up camp.

sections.title: Ready to Camp
sections.body: You can now craft a Sharpening Wheel. Take it into the wilderness to try it out, where you can set up camp away from the center of town. Bring a campfire along. A cook can teach you how to make one.

faq.answer: You can now craft your own Sharpening Wheel.

faq.q: Where can I try the Sharpening Wheel?
faq.answer: You can try it in the wilderness, where camps can be set up away from the center of town.

faq.q: What do I need before setting up camp?
faq.answer: You need a campfire before you can set up camp.

faq.q: Who can teach me to make a campfire?
faq.answer: A cook can teach you to make a campfire.

angles.text: You can now craft a Sharpening Wheel to use in the wilderness.
A cook can teach you how to make a campfire.
